sanskrit_verse:
अयं मे वज्र इत्येवं सर्वं मन्त्रं उदीरयेत् ।
वर्षत्यप्रावृतो गच्छेत् स्वपेत्प्रत्यक्षिरा न च ॥१३६॥
transliteration: ayaṃ me vajra ity evaṃ sarvaṃ mantraṃ udīrayet | varṣaty aprāvṛto gacchet svapet pratyakṣirā na ca ||136||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who recites the mantra 'This is my Vajra' in accordance with the prescribed method shall invoke the full power of the Mantra; even if rains occur out of season, he shall proceed without obstruction and sleep peacefully, untouched by external disturbances.
